gh pr diff 1227 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1227/run1/diff.patch
wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1227/run1/diff.patch
echo "===per-file added/removed==="
awk '/^diff --git/{f=$0} /^diff --git/{sub(/^diff --git a\//,"",f); sub(/ b\/.*/,"",f)} /^\+\+\+ /{print ""} /^\+/&&!/^\+\+\+/{a[f]++} /^-/&&!/^---/{r[f]++} END{for(k in a) print k, "+"a[k]}' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1227/run1/diff.patch | sort

for rid in 4849395664 4849452768; do
  gh api -X PUT "repos/The01Geek/prflow/pulls/1227/reviews/$rid/dismissals" \
    -f message="Superseded by a later PRFlow APPROVE verdict on the current head (64607003)." \
    -f event="DISMISS" --jq '{id, state}' && echo "dismissed $rid"
done
echo "=== after ==="
gh pr view 1227 --json reviewDecision --jq '.reviewDecision'
